expectedAbfa: Context probes are intended red due to missing public PublicationContext; legacy control is intended green. These are capability-gap probes, not upstream defect claims or strict-mode qualification.
contractRefinements: Read-only native context issuance may operate in default mode without changing default admission; strict mandatory host acceptance remains opt-in. This permits route diagnostics and legacy compatibility control in one source fixture.

Add read-only Quiesced Task to exact native execution context: completes only after route cannot reserve new mutations and all already reserved mutations have drained; host callback completion or transport close alone is insufficient.

Stable publication identity and per-attempt execution lease are distinct. Memory QoS2 AwaitPubRel incarnation survives reconnect with one acceptance; its old token stays cancelled, PUBREL uses only the new fenced connection for ACK. Packet-id reuse after retirement issues a new identity.

Retained replay uses stable accepted snapshot semantics. Replacement does not rewrite accepted payload under old authority. Future replay takes the newer revision; explicit cancellation/takeover still revokes the exact replay execution lease.

Context authenticity requires exact capability instance and native registry validation, not merely public immutable IDs. Strict injection needs separate instance-bound opaque capability overload; these source probes do not claim it exists.

No synchronous drain inside callbacks. Callback-triggered Stop/Disconnect/takeover must revoke and arrange asynchronous drain without awaiting the currently executing callback itself. Successor activation waits only reserved mutations, never arbitrary cancellation-ignoring user code.
